# Publication boundary

- Runtime graph and original Apache-2.0 notice are packaged; review cases/reports remain outside runtime.
- Inspect actual staged diff and new JSON/Markdown for secrets/private paths; use only public source identity/synthetic records.
- Preserve failed dependency health and required native blocks.
- Refresh catalog/index and generated coverage; full scaffold, noneditable wheel, stable-head independent review and exact-head Ready CI/admission before integration.
- No rule/workflow edits, unrelated acceptance or managed import.
